name: Blood Knight Insignia
summary: A Blood Knight Insignia is the sacred token worn by full members of the Blood Knight order. Because only a finite number of these badges were originally struck, new initiates must inherit theirs from fallen predecessors.

sections.title: Inherited Through Sacrifice
sections.body: When Lady Liadrin established the Blood Knights in Silvermoon, only a limited set of official insignias were forged. This strict tally means that the order does not simply craft fresh badges for promising initiates. Instead, an aspirant must earn the right to bear one by recovering the badge of a fallen veteran. This tradition ensures that every newly minted adept directly inherits the mantle and memory of a martyr who came before them.

sections.title: The Fall of Dawnstar
sections.body: During the ongoing struggle to cleanse Quel'Thalas, Blood Knight Dawnstar led a daring assault deep into the blighted fortress of Deatholme. Dawnstar was cut down behind the foul cauldrons near the Tower of the Damned. Initiates sent on the Path of the Adept must brave the Scourge stronghold to reclaim Dawnstar's insignia from his remains, bringing it back to Knight-Lord Bloodvalor to claim their place among the order.

faq.q: Why isn't a new insignia forged for every initiate?
faq.answer: When the Blood Knight order was founded, only a set number of insignias were forged and distributed. Because no new official badges are struck, each rising adept must take up one inherited from a fallen brother or sister in arms.

faq.q: Whose insignia is recovered in Deatholme?
faq.answer: The insignia belonged to Blood Knight Dawnstar, a brave knight who perished leading an assault against the Scourge inside the blighted stronghold of Deatholme.

faq.q: What is the insignia used for?
aliases: what do i do with the insignia
faq.answer: Initiates present the recovered insignia to Knight-Lord Bloodvalor alongside materials for a blood-tempered ranseur to prove their worthiness to join the order as full adepts.

angles.text: For blood elf paladins, recovering this insignia is an essential rite of passage, linking a rising initiate directly to the martyrs of the order.
